title: Anti-armor-dura-packs
description: Lightweight Minecraft plugin designed to spoof the durability of equipped armor to other players.
body:
Antiarmordura is a lightweight Minecraft plugin designed to provide a tactical advantage by spoofing the durability of equipped armor to other players. Utilizing ProtocolLib, it intercepts server packets to display armor as either fully repaired or having randomized durability, effectively hiding its true condition from opponents. This prevents enemies from targeting players based on low armor integrity, while ensuring the wearer can still track their own durability accurately. The plugin features per-player toggles and configurable strategies, making it a versatile tool for PvP environments.

Command:
```
/antiarmordura <player> <on|off>
```
On will spoof, off will reverse that, or else do nothing

Suggestions are open in the [discord](https://discord.gg/tabjev2y4x)
